rv.q: Ultimately, Kushner has written a play about family – its limits and, in some cases, its ability to adapt.
Radio Galaxy has moments so real that every emotion seems to pulse through the characters’ veins.
It might just turn out to be the year's best new play.
Kushner’s play brings space science into earthly human terms with humor, thoughtfulness and snowballing suspense.
Nevertheless, the overall narrative of the play is highly engaging – even powerful – as it follows Tito's journey to self-discovery.
Several judicious rewrites could transform this promising work into something exceptional; for now, its most affecting discoveries are decidedly earthbound.

Radio Galaxy @ THE WALLIS November 23, 2026. November 18, 2026 by LADCC Critics Jonas Schwartz-Owen – Theatermania Radio Galaxy is a heady play, filled with important life choices, and Kushner explores all the possibilities.

cn.t: Critics mostly praise *Radio Galaxy* for its emotional depth and compelling performances, though some find its scientific ambitions overreach. A mostly winning world premiere.
